title: Haiti police say 34 gang members killed in capital raid
text:
NewsFeed

Haiti police say 34 gang members killed in capital raid

Haitian police say at least 34 gang members were killed in an operation in Martissant, a neighbourhood in the capital, Port-au-Prince. Haiti has cracked down on gangs since El Salvador sent roughly 2,500 troops in October to assist the government’s fight to reclaim control.
